name: compare both sides applied to a random vector
mechanism: to check a claimed product, draw a random vector, multiply the claimed result by it and multiply the two factors by it in sequence, and compare; a wrong claim survives with probability at most one half per trial, and the check costs only matrix-vector products

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Freivalds' algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: a randomized algorithm used to verify matrix multiplication

fails_when: one-sided: it never rejects a correct claim, but can accept a wrong one
